 K-Beauty Brand Stocked in Old Pasadena Runs Black Friday Discounts on Amazon
 Purito Seoul, sold at Olive Young on Colorado Boulevard since May, says its online price cuts last through Nov. 30 Friday, November 20, 2026 | 3:59 am PST 2 min read

 Purito Seoul skincare products, including Mighty Bamboo Panthenol Cream and Oat In Calming Gel Cream, are shown in promotional imagery. The Korean skincare brand, whose products are sold at Olive Young's Pasadena store at 58 West Colorado Boulevard, is offering discounts of up to 72% during Amazon's Black Friday and Cyber Monday promotion through Nov. 30. [Image courtesy of Olive Young] The Korean skincare brand stocked inside a former Foot Locker on Colorado Boulevard is marking down its products for Black Friday — on Amazon. 
 Purito Seoul says it is taking part in Amazon’s Black Friday and Cyber Monday event from Nov. 19 through Nov. 30, with discounts it puts at up to 72% off list price. The company announced the promotion Thursday in a press release distributed through PR Newswire. The release describes the discounts and bundle offers as available on Amazon. 
 Olive Young, the South Korean beauty retailer, opened its first U.S. store at 58 West Colorado Boulevard on May 29. Purito announced in a press release the day before that it would meet North American shoppers through the Pasadena store. 
 Shoppers began lining up a day early. The line stretched about 400 meters across four blocks of Colorado Boulevard, Olive Young said, according to the Korea Herald. 
 According to the release, the four products Purito is featuring — the Mighty Bamboo Panthenol Cream, Retinol Retinal 2000 NAD+ Serum, Oat In Calming Gel Cream and Sun Day Adventure Sunscreen SPF 50 — are discounted by up to 48.9% off list price. The panthenol cream is marked down by as much as 40% and the serum by as much as 44%, the company said. Buying two featured products takes an extra 15% off, three takes 20% and four or more takes 25%, the release says. 
 The brand has also reached Target. Purito Seoul was among the Korean skincare brands in Target Beauty Studio, which Target launched Sept. 10. The company’s release says the brand launched in 611 Target Beauty Studio locations in September. 
 Priscilla Kang, merchandising team lead for Olive Young, told ABC7 the company was looking within Los Angeles for “an area with the most diverse demographics and a population that was more trends-forward.” 
 Gaeun Kwon, CEO of Olive Young USA, said in the retailer’s press release announcing the opening that the company aimed to create “a space where customers can discover what works best for them.” 
 “We sincerely welcome Olive Young to Pasadena,” Mayor Victor Gordo said in remarks included in an Olive Young announcement reported by the Korea Herald. 
 In May, a Purito Seoul representative, who was not named in the company’s release, said the brand was seeing “strong enthusiasm and affection for K-beauty and Korean skincare brands within the U.S. market.” 
 Olive Young Pasadena is at 58 West Colorado Boulevard. The Amazon promotion ends Nov. 30, according to the company. 
 In May, the line to reach the store that carries Purito ran four blocks down Colorado Boulevard. This holiday season, the brand’s markdowns are online.
